items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 23:1
items.html: The matter of the first six degrees of the HaVaYaH of AB, namely of the king of Hesed, of which the ARI says that they remained in Atzilut, does not mean that they did not break at all, for it is certain that all the phases of ZAT of Nekudim broke and fell to BYA, both their phase of face and their phase of posterior, as written in several places. Rather, what is meant concerns only the phase of the sparks.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 23:2
items.html: For you already know the difference between lights and sparks, which is the phase of GAR and VAK discerned in the records that remained from the lights that departed from the broken vessels. The refined light in the records, meaning their phase of GAR, remained in Atzilut in the phase of records and did not descend with the broken vessels to BYA, since the Parsa detains them; hence they cannot remain within the vessels themselves, as all records do. But the phase of the coarse light in the records, meaning their phase of VAK, since the Parsa does not detain them, can descend with the vessels to BYA and clothe in them, as all records do — understand this well. And this part of the records that descended with the vessels to BYA is always called “sparks,” while the part that remained in Atzilut is always called “records.”

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 23:3
items.html: With this you will understand that from the six first degrees of AB, which is the phase of top-to-bottom from the level of upper Aba of Nekudim that descended and expanded into the king of Hesed of Nekudim, as above in answer 96, it is impossible for sparks to descend from them to BYA, since the records that remained from these six degrees after the breaking of the king of Hesed are all a phase of GAR, and you already know that GAR of the records cannot pass the Parsa and descend to BYA. Only from the seventh degree onward, which is the phase of the Malchuyot of the phase of the ten Sefirot of the face of that level, as above in answer 95, is the phase of the coarse light in the record, namely VAK of the records, and they can descend with the vessels to BYA and clothe in them, as the records remaining in the vessels do, in order to give them life, since the Parsa does not detain them, being a phase of Hassadim upon which the restriction does not sit, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 23:4
items.html: However, the six first degrees, which are the four degrees in the Rosh of the level of AB, and the two first degrees of the Guf of the level, namely the fifth degree, which is the phase of the ten letters in their self, hinting at the first nine Sefirot, and likewise the sixth degree, which is the phase of the square of these ten letters, likewise hinting at the phase of the nine first Sefirot of the level — even the records that remained after their departure are also a phase of GAR, and cannot pass the Parsa and clothe in vessels in BYA, and this is what the ARI means when he says that no sparks descended from them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 23:5
items.html: And in like manner you will understand the matter of the remaining in Atzilut that the ARI reckons for the other levels — SAG, MA, and BON — namely only the phase of the records that remained after the departure of the lights and the breaking of the vessels; do not err into thinking that these degrees did not break at all, for it is simple that all of ZAT broke, both face and posterior, and nothing at all remained of them in Atzilut. (Etz Chaim, Gate 18, Chapter 2).
